versions.description_html:
Computer vision for safety and compliance works when the use case is narrow and the process around it is clear. In this episode of the iFAKT series, we cover what works in practice: use cases, camera placement, data privacy, accuracy and alert handling.
You will learn how to evaluate projects and avoid pilots that never reach production.
Who it is for: Safety managers, quality teams and manufacturing AI leads.
